info.title: Apple Asset Tracking API
info.description: Web backend for the RFID asset-management application (port 3601). All endpoints except the public allowlist (login/password flows, RFID device endpoints, downloads) require a JWT: click Authorize and enter "Bearer <token>" using the token field from the POST /login response.

post.description: Validates the employee code + password and returns the JWT (token), the user profile (send) and the per-screen permissions (pagedata). Use the token for every other endpoint: Authorize with "Bearer <token>". Wrong password increments the login-attempt counter; the account locks after the configured attempt count.

parameters.name: body
parameters.description: Login credentials. ipAddress is recorded in the login history.

200.description: Login success — token, user profile, page permissions

post.description: Verifies the old password and stores the new one (bcrypt-hashed). Used by the first-time-login screen. Public: it authenticates via the old password itself.

post.summary: Forgot password — reset to default and mail it
post.description: Verifies employee code + date of joining + email; on match, resets the password to the branch default and emails it to the user. Public (pre-login).

Creates an asset via the AssetRegisterMaster stored procedure. mode "I" inserts. Dates are dd-mm-yyyy or ISO strings; PCost is the purchase cost; AssetImg is the uploaded image path from POST /api/upload.
Returns every registered asset for the branch (assetInfo stored procedure). Large payload — the response is gzip-compressed.
Fetches registered asset rows via AssetRegisterMaster. mode "S" lists; pass an id to fetch a single asset (id "" for all).
Manages RFID-tagged physical locations (building + floor + room + location tag). Common modes: I = insert, U = update, getLocation = list locations for dropdowns.

Returns the four dashboard card groups in one call: assets (total / with RFID / without RFID + values), maintenance (under maintenance, due date crossed), scrap count and maintenance cost. Filtered by department, branch and branch access.

Runs the Dashboard stored procedure for the given mode and returns the rows. Modes: SM = recent operations activity, SUM = unauthorized movements, FetchAuthdata = authorized movements, UM = unauthorized movements AND sends the alert mails (side effect — use with care). The dashboard normally receives this data pushed over the WebSocket /ws/dashboard.

Asset distribution counts for the dashboard charts. Modes: PackageCount (by package), GroupCount (by asset group), FloorCount (by floor). LocationRFID filters to one location; use "All" or "" for every location.
multipart/form-data: file (xlsx/csv with columns Depreciation, Use Life, Salvage Value), branchid, Createdby. Skipped rows come back as a downloadable error workbook.
